pages.title: Hybrid
pages.text: $(l)Health$(): 1000, shields 500$(br)$(l)Damage$(): 45, every 1.2 s, range 1$(br)$(l)Speed$(): 3.5, on the ground$(br2)$(o)StarCraft II numbers (LotV).$()
Moebius's hybrid, zerg and protoss in one: it blinks behind its foe with a psionic shockwave and, hurt, calls psionic storms. It leaves the Xel'Naga relic.
